1. Grammarly Premium — Overview

Grammarly Premium is the safety net that catches you before you send an email with a typo to your biggest client.. In our testing over two weeks of real business use, we found it to be a standout performer in the grammar & style category.

This review is based on hands-on testing with real business scenarios, analysis of 2156+ user reviews across Trustpilot, G2, and Reddit, and pricing verification direct from the vendor. We are not sponsored by Grammarly Premium. Some links may be affiliate links.

Pros and Cons

Pros

  • The browser extension means it works everywhere you write, not just in documents
  • Tone detection genuinely improves business communication
  • The free version catches 90% of common errors. Most people never need Premium
  • British English support is accurate, not an afterthought
  • Plagiarism checker is faster and more comprehensive than many dedicated tools

Cons

  • Premium suggestions can be overly aggressive
  • The generative AI features (Grammarly Go) feel bolted on and produce bland text
  • Privacy concerns for regulated industries
  • Sometimes conflicts with other browser extensions, causing Gmail to lag
  • The Business plan requires minimum three users, excluding solo founders

What Users Say

What Users Say

  • It often tries to correct British English spellings to American. You have to set your language to British English explicitly.

    Emily S.Copywriter, GlasgowG2Neutral

  • Great for basic grammar, but the premium suggestions can make writing sound robotic. Use your judgment.

    Alex T.Journalist, CardiffRedditNeutral

3. ChatGPT Plus — Overview

ChatGPT Plus is the swiss army knife of writing tools. for writers who jump between formats and audiences, it is unbeatable value.. In our testing over two weeks of real business use, we found it to be a standout performer in the ai assistant category.

This review is based on hands-on testing with real business scenarios, analysis of 1247+ user reviews across Trustpilot, G2, and Reddit, and pricing verification direct from the vendor. We are not sponsored by ChatGPT Plus. Some links may be affiliate links.

Pros and Cons

Pros

  • The most versatile writing tool available. One subscription replaces multiple specialised tools
  • Custom instructions save time. Set your preferences once, not every conversation
  • The £16 price point makes it accessible for freelancers and small businesses
  • Voice mode turns dead time (commutes, walks) into productive writing sessions
  • Web browsing means your content can reference current events and data

Cons

  • Hallucinations are a real risk. Always verify facts, quotes, and statistics before publishing
  • No native brand voice training like Jasper. You must craft detailed prompts for consistency
  • The interface is a chat window, not a writing environment. Long-form drafting feels clunky
  • No built-in SEO guidance. You need Surfer or manual keyword research alongside it
  • Privacy concerns for sensitive client work. Do not upload confidential briefs

6. Hemingway Editor — Overview

Hemingway Editor is the antidote to bloated business writing. shows you what is wrong and lets you fix it. the result is writing that sounds like a human, not an algorithm.. In our testing over two weeks of real business use, we found it to be solid but with some caveats in the readability category.

This review is based on hands-on testing with real business scenarios, analysis of 278+ user reviews across Trustpilot, G2, and Reddit, and pricing verification direct from the vendor. We are not sponsored by Hemingway Editor. Some links may be affiliate links.

Pros and Cons

Pros

  • The one-time £15 price is exceptional value. No subscriptions, no upsells
  • Readability scores are based on established formulas, not arbitrary AI judgments
  • The highlighting system teaches you to write better, not just corrects you
  • Export to HTML produces clean code without Word's bloated formatting
  • Works offline. No internet connection required

Cons

  • It is an editor, not a writer. You still need to produce the content yourself
  • The colour highlighting can feel judgmental
  • No AI generation features. For drafting, you need another tool
  • The desktop app is more reliable than the web version for large documents
  • British English support is limited

Which Tool Should You Choose?

For everyday business writing: Start with Grammarly Premium. The tone detector and clarity suggestions improve every email, proposal, and report you write.

For content marketing: Combine ChatGPT Plus for drafting with Surfer SEO for optimisation. Add Jasper if you publish more than five articles per month and need brand consistency.

For marketing copy and social media: Copy.ai's templates and workflows save hours on ad copy, product descriptions, and social posts.

For readability and polish: Run every important document through Hemingway Editor. The \u00a315 one-time purchase pays for itself in clearer communication.

The ultimate stack: ChatGPT Plus (\u00a316) + Grammarly Premium (\u00a310) + Surfer SEO (\u00a350) + Hemingway (\u00a315 one-time) = \u00a376/month for a content production system that rivals agencies charging \u00a32,000 per month.
